pipeline.name: Observation
pipeline.canonical_rule: input observation authority is separate from output presentation directions

pipeline.name: Geometry / IRIS
pipeline.role: signed field and dense surface evidence
pipeline.canonical_rule: geometry owns surface evidence and silhouette capacity; it does not own RGB

pipeline.name: GSA
pipeline.canonical_rule: relation construction is independently audited because it can alter triangle quality

pipeline.name: CanonicalMeshDomain
pipeline.canonical_rule: mesh + stable addressing + appearance domain are born together before branch split

pipeline.name: Appearance / CAA
pipeline.canonical_rule: source wins; totality + holdout + seam + exposure + premultiplied sampling; no geometry mutation

pipeline.name: Mechanics / Geppetto+Arachne
pipeline.canonical_rule: models propose; Compiler owns legal canonical mechanics

pipeline.name: DynamicMechanicalMesh
pipeline.canonical_rule: frozen mesh is stress-tested; repair returns to new mesh lineage

pipeline.name: Presentation
pipeline.canonical_rule: structure only; cannot invent geometry or appearance

pipeline.name: Motion
pipeline.canonical_rule: operates sealed puppet; appearance exposure is measured, not forbidden merely for being rest-unobserved

pipeline.name: Runtime
pipeline.canonical_rule: posed canonical XYZ + z-buffer for visibility; sealed CAA for art; no donor search/generation/relighting

pipeline.name: DynamicVisualIntegrity
pipeline.canonical_rule: separately attributes geometry holes, depth ownership, appearance definedness, alpha/sampling, seams, flicker and composition

pipeline.name: Closure
pipeline.canonical_rule: requires all three co-equal quality axes plus native runtime evidence

settled_invariants: Geometry, mechanics and appearance are co-equal product-quality authorities.
A visually incorrect puppet is not a mechanically successful RealSaS product.
Mesh is the common canonical domain for mechanics and appearance.
Visibility authority is canonical posed XYZ plus camera/depth; texture alpha is art coverage and cannot replace depth ownership.
CAA is total over supported renderable surface states and may not mutate canonical geometry.
Qualified source appearance wins over completion and remains provenance-locked.
Presentation geometry warp is forbidden in CAA V1.
Internal appearance filtering/compositing is premultiplied alpha with canonical atlas bleed.
Runtime performs no generative/corrective appearance inference or character relighting.
Mesh producer/gate feasibility is proved upstream; thresholds are not weakened after witness inspection.
V2 executor uses DAG dependencies; ordinals are documentation only.
Downstream failure does not erase verified independent upstream PASS.
Knight execution is forbidden until V2_IMPLEMENTATION_READINESS is READY_FOR_WITNESS_EXECUTION.
Product closure is Stage46 and requires native Dynamic Visual Integrity.

geometry.responsibility: renderable canonical surface, silhouette capacity, addressability, topology and rasterizable conditioning

mechanics.responsibility: skeleton, skin, deformation, contacts, motion and dynamic conditioning

appearance.responsibility: source-faithful total 2D art, provenance, completion quality, seams, alpha/sampling and temporal visual continuity

product_quality_axes.rule: A failure on any one axis is a product failure; no axis may hide another axis's error.
